claude-sdk-setup.title: Claude Agent SDK · Target node setup
claude-sdk-setup.intro: Enter the target machine's public paths and model settings. Copy the command to its terminal; the original Runner validates the host assets and prepares a new configuration file.
claude-sdk-setup.versions: Required versions: SDK 0.3.314 and native CLI 2.1.314. These fixed requirements are not a local version probe.
claude-sdk-setup.field.nativeCLI: Reviewed native Claude CLI absolute path
claude-sdk-setup.field.credentialEnvRef: Local API key environment variable name
claude-sdk-setup.help.shell: Choose PowerShell or Bash explicitly. The browser's operating system does not determine the target environment.
claude-sdk-setup.help.node: Enter the target machine's node or node.exe absolute path. Its Runner validates the actual executable.
claude-sdk-setup.help.host: Choose suma-claude.bundle.mjs with its complete adjacent manifest assets. The Runner calculates their hashes; do not enter digests or arguments.
claude-sdk-setup.help.nativeCLI: Enter the reviewed standalone CLI executable, not a Node script or shell wrapper. The Runner validates the pinned version on the target machine.
claude-sdk-setup.help.model: Enter the complete administrator-confirmed claude-* model ID. This form does not query model availability.
claude-sdk-setup.help.credentialEnvRef: For example, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Enter only its name. Set the secret value securely on the target machine; do not paste it here.
claude-sdk-setup.help.commands: Use a new absolute .json path outside the SDK host asset directory. The Runner refuses to overwrite an existing file.
claude-sdk-setup.prepare_title: Prepare configuration on the target node
claude-sdk-setup.prepare_help: Run this command in the chosen target terminal. It sends the explicit public settings to the original Runner through literal JSON stdin.
claude-sdk-setup.draft_ready: This is a command draft. The browser has not generated a configuration file or checked local assets.
claude-sdk-setup.incomplete: Complete all seven fields with explicit target paths, a supported shell, a complete model ID, a valid credential variable name and a new .json file path.
claude-sdk-setup.copy_failed: Copying did not complete. The exact command remains above for manual copying; your input draft is preserved.
claude-sdk-setup.continue_title: Continue with the original execution node
claude-sdk-setup.continue_help: After preparing the file on the target machine, use its existing identity to report fresh tool inventory. Register paused, review and explicitly enable through the existing workflow.
claude-sdk-setup.use_configuration: Use this path for the execution node
claude-sdk-setup.handoff_boundary: This passes only the shell, configuration path and SDK tool choice into a draft. It does not create a file, connect, report, register, enable or start a task.
claude-sdk-setup.details: View verification boundaries and next command
claude-sdk-setup.verification_boundary: File preparation checks are owned by the target Runner. Fixed versions, a copied command and a configuration draft do not establish account access, model availability or successful execution.
claude-sdk-setup.describe_title: Describe tools from the prepared file
claude-sdk-setup.observation_boundary: Enter the real repository and full baseline commit on the target machine. SDK results, a sealed candidate, independent tests and human acceptance remain separate facts.
